notes: Same drawing as the suit-3pc twin: lapel and collar front, one small red slash high on the frame-right lapel, plus a red magnifier oval containing an enlarged red-and-blue buttonhole - oval and colours are annotation only. Candidate: one hand-worked straight real buttonhole on the frame-right lapel, equal fine raised lips either side of a cut slit, plain bar at each end, purl stitches individually resolvable, no rounded keyhole eye, no flat machine look, no fake stitch line with no opening. No red, no blue, no oval, no leader line, no numerals, no text. No tie, no boutonniere, no lapel pin, no face or skin in frame. Crop shows the full lapel width with shirt beyond. Buttonhole is larger in frame and the crop is cleaner than the suit-3pc twin; the two remain consistent in geometry.
